title: Orchestrator state-machine tests: Hypothesis spike vs subsumed random-sequence tester
observation: No property/state-machine tests exist (implementation-status RT-27). The constitution lists lifecycle operations and invariants to test. Prior art PA-hypothesis (RuleBasedStateMachine with shrinking) is best-in-class; the operator prefers subsuming over dependencies.
suggested_direction: Write engine invariants once (unvalidated code never integrates, failed never becomes integrated, read-only never writes, COMPLETE requires completion validation). Drive them with (a) a small in-repo seeded random operation-sequence runner and (b) Hypothesis as a dev-only extra; compare bugs found, runtime and failure readability; record EXP + DEC.
acceptance: Invariant set covers the constitution section 10 list
Both drivers run against synthetic adapters in < 60 s
EXP/DEC records the choice with evidence
